theme: One quiet day at sea before a long travel weekend.
greeting: You're on the water, Dan, on the last full day of the charter before the crossing home begins. Nothing needs you at sea, but the disembark and the Florida landing both want arranging while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Disembark day is fully loaded
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends around noon Saturday at Komolac; the transfer to the Cavtat hotel, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and a ~5:15 AM Sunday departure for the 7:30 flight all need arranging from land before you sail out of range.

needsAttention.title: St Pete stay was set to charge today
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 to Oct 5 St Pete booking charged today after the host's 24-hour confirmation window; worth a glance that it converted to confirmed rather than expiring unaccepted.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for the landing
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday afternoon with no car; the full-size SUV for Sept 20 to Oct 5 needs booking before you arrive jet-lagged to walk-up rates.

flagged.title: VP, US Government Relations at Westinghouse
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert surfaced a VP of US Government Relations role at Westinghouse Electric.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto conference push
flagged.detail: ICGN is nudging you to register for its autumn governance conference in Toronto.

inbox.noise: Everything else is retail and newsletters: Delta, Indochino, Monocle, Duolingo, and an Apple receipt.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first winter squash and pumpkins to the market, sweet and ready for the oven.

tasks.title: Book the St Pete gap nights, Sept 20 to 22
Sort Disney tickets for the six of you

acts.line: Last full day of the Croatia charter, with open water and nothing on the calendar.
The passage bends south toward Dubrovnik; only the sailing is scheduled.
A last night aboard before you dock at Komolac and move to the Cavtat hotel tomorrow.
